transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess the main thing is my eating’s been kind of off the past few weeks. I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then even at dinner I just kind of pick at food, even when my wife’s cooked. My jeans are starting to feel loose, so I figured I should bring it up.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… most days lately I’ve been waking up with this heavy, kind of flat feeling. The apartment feels really quiet, and even stuff I usually like, like picking up my guitar, doesn’t really lift me much.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I don’t think so… I mean, I’ve felt pretty low, but I haven’t really been thinking about hurting myself or anything like that.
When you sit down to eat, do you actually feel hungry?

Not really, no. I’ll sit down and realize I haven’t eaten all day, but I don’t feel that hungry. Even at dinner, I mostly just pick at it, even if my wife made something. It’s been going on a few weeks, and my jeans are feeling looser.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I think so. Like, I’ll pick up my guitar, which usually helps me feel better, and it just kind of… doesn’t do much. Most days I wake up feeling heavy and flat, and things just don’t really land the same.
Has anything particularly stressful or upsetting happened in your life around the time this started?
I guess the main thing is my wife started her full-time work schedule, and after that I kind of slipped into this low stretch. It’s been about three weeks now.
Lately, have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty?
I don’t think so. I mean, I feel bad that I’m not really myself lately, but I wouldn’t say I feel worthless or overly guilty.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Yeah, a bit. When I try to work on code or arrange a song, I’ll keep rereading the same line, or replaying the same few bars over and over, and I still can’t really decide what to do next.
Have you been sleeping more or less than usual lately?
I’m sleeping, but it’s not really solid sleep. I’ll wake up around four or five, usually thinking about bills or some track I haven’t finished, and then I’m already tired before the day even starts.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?
Yeah, I think so. Everything just feels slower right now. I’ll sit there with my laptop open for a long time before I even start typing or plug in the keyboard.
Have you been worrying a lot more than usual lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I worry some, but I haven’t noticed it being a lot more than usual.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I don’t know that it’s unusual. I’ve been tired, but I can’t really tell if it’s more than normal or just from not sleeping great.
Have these symptoms been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yeah, somewhat. I’m still doing the basic stuff around the house, but I’m not really moving forward on my own projects. And I’ve missed some chances to follow up with musicians I’d contacted, so things have kind of stalled there.
Have you lost weight during this time?

Yeah, I think maybe a little. I haven’t been weighing myself, but my eating’s been off the last few weeks. I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then even at dinner I’m just kind of picking at food. My jeans are starting to feel looser, so I think I’ve probably lost some weight.
Do you feel like these symptoms mainly happened because of your wife starting her full-time work schedule?
Yeah, I think that was probably part of it. This low stretch has been going on about three weeks, and it seemed to start after she got settled into her full-time schedule.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?

Yeah… I’ve been feeling pretty low most days. I don’t know if I’d call it completely hopeless, but I wake up with this heavy, flat feeling, like the apartment is too quiet. Even picking up my guitar doesn’t really lift it much.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable for several days in a row?

Yeah, before this low spell I did have a stretch like that. I felt really fired up, like I was on a roll, and I’d get annoyed fast if anything interrupted me. Even small stuff would make me snap more than usual.
During that fired-up stretch, did you need much less sleep than usual?
Yeah. For several nights I was only sleeping maybe three or four hours, but I’d still wake up feeling wired, like sleep was just in the way of finishing another track or working on a spreadsheet.
During that fired-up stretch, did it cause major problems in your life or lead to you being hospitalized?

No, not hospitalized or anything like that. It didn’t completely wreck things at home—I was still managing the basics. But yeah, it did mess with follow-through. Some projects stalled out, and I missed chances to keep things going with musicians I’d reached out to.
During that fired-up stretch, were you more active than usual in starting or pushing ahead with projects?

Yeah, definitely. I was taking on way more than I usually would. I started making lists of musicians to reach out to, sending a bunch of messages, putting together pitch decks, and planning possible collaborations all in the same week. It felt like I could push everything forward at once.
